verses.original: γὰρ μὲν Περὶ τῆς διακονίας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους ἐστιν περισσόν μοί τὸ γράφειν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: gar men Peri tēs diakonias tēs eis tous hagious estin perisson moi to graphein hymin
verses.literal: Now . . . about the service - to the saints there is no need for me - to write to you

verses.original: γὰρ οἶδα ὑμῶν τὴν προθυμίαν ἣν καυχῶμαι Μακεδόσιν ὅτι ἀπὸ πέρυσι ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν Ἀχαΐα παρεσκεύασται καὶ ὑμῶν τὸ ζῆλος ἠρέθισεν τοὺς πλείονας
verses.transliteration: gar oida hymōn tēn prothymian hēn kauchōmai Makedosin hoti apo perysi hyper hymōn Achaia pareskeuastai kai hymōn to zēlos ērethisen tous pleionas
verses.literal: For I know your - eagerness [to help] [and] I have been boasting to [the] Macedonians that since last year - you in Achaia were prepared [ to give ] And your - zeal has stirred - most of them [ to do likewise ]

verses.original: δὲ Ἔπεμψα τοὺς ἀδελφούς ἵνα ἡμῶν τὸ καύχημα τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐν τούτῳ τῷ μέρει μὴ κενωθῇ ἵνα ἦτε παρεσκευασμένοι καθὼς ἔλεγον
verses.transliteration: de Epempsa tous adelphous hina hēmōn to kauchēma to hyper hymōn en toutō tō merei mē kenōthē hina ēte pareskeuasmenoi kathōs elegon
verses.literal: But I am sending the brothers in order that our - boasting - about you in this - matter vvv should not prove empty [but] that you will be prepared just as I said

verses.original: μή πως ἐὰν Μακεδόνες ἔλθωσιν σὺν ἐμοὶ καὶ εὕρωσιν ὑμᾶς ἀπαρασκευάστους ἡμεῖς ἵνα λέγωμεν μὴ ὑμεῖς καταισχυνθῶμεν ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ὑποστάσει
verses.transliteration: mē pōs ean Makedones elthōsin syn emoi kai heurōsin hymas aparaskeuastous hēmeis hina legōmen mē hymeis kataischynthōmen en tautē tē hypostasei
verses.literal: Otherwise . . . if [any] Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared we to say nothing of you would be ashamed of [having been] so - confident

verses.original: οὖν ἡγησάμην ἀναγκαῖον παρακαλέσαι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἵνα προέλθωσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ προκαταρτίσωσιν τὴν εὐλογίαν προεπηγγελμένην οὕτως ὑμῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἑτοίμην ὡς εὐλογίαν καὶ μὴ ὡς πλεονεξίαν
verses.transliteration: oun hēgēsamēn anankaion parakalesai tous adelphous hina proelthōsin eis hymas kai prokatartisōsin tēn eulogian proepēngelmenēn houtōs hymōn tautēn einai hetoimēn hōs eulogian kai mē hōs pleonexian
verses.literal: So I thought [it] necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand . . . . . . and make arrangements for the generous gift you had promised This way your [gift] will be prepared vvv generously and not vvv begrudgingly

verses.original: δέ Τοῦτο ὁ σπείρων φειδομένως καὶ θερίσει φειδομένως καὶ ὁ σπείρων ἐπ’ εὐλογίαις καὶ θερίσει ἐπ’ εὐλογίαις
verses.transliteration: de Touto ho speirōn pheidomenōs kai therisei pheidomenōs kai ho speirōn ep’ eulogiais kai therisei ep’ eulogiais
verses.literal: [Remember] this Whoever sows sparingly {will} also reap sparingly and whoever sows vvv generously {will} also reap vvv generously

verses.original: ἕκαστος καθὼς προῄρηται τῇ καρδίᾳ μὴ ἐκ λύπης ἢ ἐξ ἀνάγκης γὰρ ὁ Θεός ἀγαπᾷ ἱλαρὸν δότην
verses.transliteration: hekastos kathōs proērētai tē kardia mē ek lypēs ē ex anankēs gar ho Theos agapa hilaron dotēn
verses.literal: Each one [ should give ] what he has decided in [his] heart [to give ] not out of regret or - compulsion For - God loves a cheerful giver

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Θεὸς δυνατεῖ πᾶσαν χάριν περισσεῦσαι εἰς ὑμᾶς ἵνα ἐν παντὶ πάντοτε ἔχοντες πᾶσαν αὐτάρκειαν περισσεύητε εἰς πᾶν ἀγαθόν ἔργον
verses.transliteration: de ho Theos dynatei pasan charin perisseusai eis hymas hina en panti pantote echontes pasan autarkeian perisseuēte eis pan agathon ergon
verses.literal: And - God [is] able {to make} all grace abound to you so that in all things at all times having all that you need you will abound in every good work

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ἐσκόρπισεν ἔδωκεν τοῖς πένησιν αὐτοῦ ἡ δικαιοσύνη μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Eskorpisen edōken tois penēsin autou hē dikaiosynē menei eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: As it is written He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor His - righteousness endures forever . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἐπιχορηγῶν σπόρον τῷ σπείροντι καὶ ἄρτον εἰς βρῶσιν χορηγήσει καὶ πληθυνεῖ ὑμῶν τὸν σπόρον καὶ αὐξήσει τὰ γενήματα τῆς ὑμῶν δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: de Ho epichorēgōn sporon tō speironti kai arton eis brōsin chorēgēsei kai plēthynei hymōn ton sporon kai auxēsei ta genēmata tēs hymōn dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your - store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness

verses.original: πλουτιζόμενοι ἐν παντὶ εἰς ἁπλότητα πᾶσαν ἥτις δι’ ἡμῶν κατεργάζεται εὐχαριστίαν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ploutizomenoi en panti eis haplotēta pasan hētis di’ hēmōn katergazetai eucharistian tō Theō
verses.literal: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every [occasion] [and] through us [your generosity] will produce thanksgiving - to God

verses.original: ὅτι ταύτης ἡ διακονία τῆς λειτουργίας ἐστὶν οὐ μόνον προσαναπληροῦσα τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν ἁγίων ἀλλὰ καὶ περισσεύουσα διὰ πολλῶν εὐχαριστιῶν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: hoti tautēs hē diakonia tēs leitourgias estin ou monon prosanaplērousa ta hysterēmata tōn hagiōn alla kai perisseuousa dia pollōn eucharistiōn tō Theō
verses.literal: For this - ministry - of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but vvv is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving - to God

verses.original: διὰ τῆς δοκιμῆς ταύτης τῆς διακονίας δοξάζοντες Θεὸν τὸν ἐπὶ τῇ ὑμῶν τῆς ὑποταγῇ ὁμολογίας εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἁπλότητι τῆς κοινωνίας εἰς αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰς πάντας
verses.transliteration: dia tēs dokimēs tautēs tēs diakonias doxazontes Theon ton epi tē hymōn tēs hypotagē homologias eis to euangelion tou Christou kai haplotēti tēs koinōnias eis autous kai eis pantas
verses.literal: Because of the proof this - ministry {provides} [the saints] will glorify God - for - your - obedient confession of the gospel - of Christ and [for the] generosity of [your] contribution to them and to all [the others]

verses.original: καὶ αὐτῶν δεήσει ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐπιποθούντων ὑμᾶς διὰ τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐφ’ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai autōn deēsei hyper hymōn epipothountōn hymas dia tēn hyperballousan charin tou Theou eph’ hymin
verses.literal: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you because of the surpassing grace - God [has given] you

verses.original: Χάρις τῷ Θεῷ ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ ἀνεκδιηγήτῳ τῇ δωρεᾷ
verses.transliteration: Charis tō Theō epi autou anekdiēgētō tē dōrea
verses.literal: Thanks [be] - to God for His indescribable - gift
